name: Chibi History
description: A soft 2D cartoon history channel: round-headed chibi archetypes in generic period uniforms (officer, soldier, sailor, pilot, diplomat, general, civilian, nurse, historian) with real flags, a stylised Europe map with fronts, arrows and red targets, letters that get no reply, split-screen two-sides framing, chunky thumbnail lettering and date tags. Told from both sides, with sweat drops and anger marks instead of anything graphic.
fonts: "Arial Black", "Segoe UI", Arial, Helvetica, "Noto Sans", system-ui, sans-serif
